recommended_approach: Use a Mantaflow Gas setup driven and controlled through Blender’s fluid RNA types: configure the simulation Domain via `bpy.types.FluidDomainSettings` and the emitter (Flow) via `bpy.types.FluidFlowSettings`, leveraging the documented noise-related attributes (`FluidDomainSettings.noise_strength`, `FluidDomainSettings.noise_time_anim`) and flow noise input (`FluidFlowSettings.noise_texture`) to add/animate fine-scale detail appropriate for a slow, candle-like flame.

key_parameters.FluidDomainSettings.noise_strength: Primary control for how strong added noise detail is in the gas domain (documented as `bpy.types.FluidDomainSettings.noise_strength`).
key_parameters.FluidDomainSettings.noise_time_anim: Use to time-animate noise detail in the domain for evolving flame/smoke structure (documented as `bpy.types.FluidDomainSettings.noise_time_anim`).
key_parameters.FluidFlowSettings.noise_texture: Optional texture input used to modulate/drive flow noise at the emitter level (documented as `bpy.types.FluidFlowSettings.noise_texture`).
key_parameters.FluidDomainSettings.flip_ratio: Domain attribute available on `bpy.types.FluidDomainSettings` (listed in the API index as `flip_ratio`).
